description: Golden test-execution batch report: the S5.2 'report JSON parseable + 10/10 files covered' shape. The M2 scorer (bench.score.m2) scores a subagent's test-batch report against THIS shape: it must (a) parse as JSON, and (b) cover all 10 files with a per-file pass/fail verdict. The 10 files are named files-000..files-009; 8 pass, 2 fail (files-003 and files-007) — the 10/10 coverage is what is scored, not the pass rate.
